# Lavendar Lewis & Stephen Irving

- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Romantically involved with — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) — engaged twenty-five years ago · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss Lavendar at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Stephen asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to inquire if he may visit Miss Lavendar, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to carry a message and help Miss Lavendar prepare for his arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

> [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss Lavendar. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) greets him at the door and ushers him inside to meet Miss Lavendar. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) watch from the window and celebrate when they see Stephen and Miss Lavendar walking together affectionately in the garden.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The ceremony goes wonderfully as the sun breaks through the clouds, and the guests see off the newlyweds. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) waits with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the quiet house, where a moment of realization sparks a shift in how she perceives [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and her own maturity.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_
